findings.failureScenario: KeywordsPanel loads the keyword list of the active photo only (photo.inspect {id}), but add() and remove() send photo.setMeta {ids: snapshot.selection, keywords: next}. In the engine, `keywords` replaces the list (m.keywords.clear() then re-add) for every id. With photos A (active, keywords [beach]) and B (keywords [wedding, family]) selected, typing 'sunset' and pressing Add sets B's keywords to [beach, sunset]: B silently loses wedding/family and gains beach. Removing a chip likewise rewrites every selected photo to the active photo's remaining list.
findings.action: Use addKeywords / removeKeywords (which the command already supports) for add/remove on a multi-selection, or send the replacing `keywords` list only for the active photo id; reload the shown list after the command instead of trusting local state.

findings.failureScenario: The Remove panel's Size slider and number field only update local state `size`, which is never read or sent; spot.add takes its size from the drag distance in StageWorkspace (Math.max(0.005, |dx| || 0.025)). A user who sets Size to 0.2 and clicks the photo still gets a 0.025 spot, so the control does nothing.
findings.action: Store the size in UI state (setUi) and pass it to spot.add when the drag is a click, or remove the dead control.
